requirements.text: If "systematic failures in use" occur for a type of retro-reflective material, the tested material samples shall be transferred for appraisal to the authority which granted approval.
requirements.quote: If "systematic failures in use" occur for a type of retro-reflective material, the tested material samples shall be transferred for appraisal to the authority which granted approval.

requirements.text: The authority which granted approval shall have the right to check the stability in time of the optical properties of a type of rear marking plate in service.
requirements.quote: The authority which granted approval shall have the right to check the stability in time of the optical properties of a type of rear marking plate in service.

requirements.text: The Type Approval Authorities of countries other than the country in which approval was granted may carry out similar checks in their territory.
requirements.quote: The Type Approval Authorities of countries other than the country in which approval was granted may carry out similar checks in their territory.

requirements.text: If a type of rear marking plate in use exhibits a systematic defect, the said authorities shall transmit to the authority which granted approval, with a request for its opinion, any components removed for examination.
requirements.quote: If a type of rear marking plate in use exhibits a systematic defect, the said authorities shall transmit to the authority which granted approval, with a request for its opinion, any components removed for examination.

requirements.text: In the absence of other criteria, the concept of "systematic defect" of a type of rear marking plate in use shall be interpreted in conformity with the intention of paragraph 5. of Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: In the absence of other criteria, the concept of "systematic defect" of a type of rear marking plate in use shall be interpreted in conformity with the intention of paragraph 5. of Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: The illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Classes IIIA and IIIB must have the shape or an equilateral triangle.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Classes IIIA and IIIB must have the shape or an equilateral triangle.

requirements.text: If the word “TOP” is inscribed in one corner, the apex of that corner must be directed upwards.
requirements.quote: If the word “TOP” is inscribed in one corner, the apex of that corner must be directed upwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface may or may not be continuous.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface may or may not be continuous.

requirements.text: In any case, the shortest distance between two adjacent retro-reflecting optical units must not exceed 15 mm.
requirements.quote: In any case, the shortest distance between two adjacent retro-reflecting optical units must not exceed 15 mm.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of a retro-reflective device shall be considered to be continuous if the edges of the illuminating surfaces of adjacent separate optical units are parallel and if the said optical units are evenly distributed over the whole solid surface of the triangle.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface of a retro-reflective device shall be considered to be continuous if the edges of the illuminating surfaces of adjacent separate optical units are parallel and if the said optical units are evenly distributed over the whole solid surface of the triangle.

requirements.text: If the illuminated surface is not continuous, the number of separate retro-reflecting optical units including the corner units shall not be less than four on each side of the triangle.
requirements.quote: If the illuminated surface is not continuous, the number of separate retro-reflecting optical units including the corner units shall not be less than four on each side of the triangle.

requirements.text: The separate retro-reflecting optical units shall not be replaceable unless they consist of approved retro-reflective devices of Class IA.
requirements.quote: The separate retro-reflecting optical units shall not be replaceable unless they consist of approved retro-reflective devices of Class IA.

requirements.text: The outside edges of the illuminating surfaces of triangular retro-reflective devices of Classes IIIA and IIIB shall be between 150 and 200 mm long.
requirements.quote: The outside edges of the illuminating surfaces of triangular retro-reflective devices of Classes IIIA and IIIB shall be between 150 and 200 mm long.

requirements.text: In the case of devices of hollow-triangle type, the width of the sides, measured at right angles to the latter, shall be equal to at least 20 per cent of the effective length between the extremities of the illuminating surface.
requirements.quote: In the case of devices of hollow-triangle type, the width of the sides, measured at right angles to the latter, shall be equal to at least 20 per cent of the effective length between the extremities of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The shape of the light emitting surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the light emitting surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: The light emitting surface of the retro-reflective device must be at least 25 cm2.
requirements.quote: The light emitting surface of the retro-reflective device must be at least 25 cm2.

requirements.text: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
requirements.quote: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.

requirements.text: The markings shall be made of strips of retro-reflective material.
requirements.quote: General The markings shall be made of strips of retro-reflective material.

requirements.text: The width of a retro-reflective marking material shall be 50 mm +10/-0 mm.
requirements.quote: The width of a retro-reflective marking material shall be 50 mm +10/-0 mm

requirements.text: The minimum length of an element of a retro-reflective marking material shall be such that at least one approval mark is visible.
requirements.quote: The minimum length of an element of a retro-reflective marking material shall be such that at least one approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: The markings shall be made of strips of retro-reflective material or plates.
requirements.quote: General The markings shall be made of strips of retro-reflective material or plates.

requirements.text: Class F and Class 5 retro-reflective markings shall consist of red and white diagonal stripes downwards at 45° ± 1° as shown in Figures A5-II, A5-III and A5-IV respectively.
requirements.quote: Class F and Class 5 retro-reflective markings shall consist of red and white diagonal stripes downwards at 45° ± 1° as shown in Figures A5-II, A5-III and A5-IV respectively.

requirements.text: The minimum length of an element of a retro-reflective marking material or plate shall incorporate a minimum of 9 standard areas as described in paragraph 5.2.1. on large vehicles with available mounting space, but may be reduced to a minimum of 3 standard areas on vehicles with limited mounting space.
requirements.quote: The minimum length of an element of a retro-reflective marking material or plate shall incorporate a minimum of 9 standard areas as described in paragraph 5.2.1. on large vehicles with available mounting space, but may be reduced to a minimum of 3 standard areas on vehicles with limited mounting space.

requirements.text: The plates shall be rectangular in shape for mounting at the rear of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Shape The plates shall be rectangular in shape for mounting at the rear of vehicles.

requirements.text: For mounting on trailers and semi-trailers, the plates shall have a yellow retro-reflective background with a red fluorescent or retro-reflective border.
requirements.quote: Pattern For mounting on trailers and semi-trailers, the plates shall have a yellow retro-reflective background with a red fluorescent or retro-reflective border;

requirements.text: For mounting on non‑articulated vehicles (tractors or trucks), the plates shall be of the chevron type with alternate, oblique stripes of yellow retro-reflective and red fluorescent or retro-reflective materials or devices.
requirements.quote: For mounting on non‑articulated vehicles (tractors or trucks), the plates shall be of the chevron type with alternate, oblique stripes of yellow retro-reflective and red fluorescent or retro-reflective materials or devices.

requirements.text: The minimum total summarized length of a set of rear marking plates consisting only of one, two or four marking plates with retro-reflective and fluorescent materials shall be 1,130 mm, the maximum total length shall be 2,300 mm.
requirements.quote: Dimensions The minimum total summarized length of a set of rear marking plates consisting only of one, two or four marking plates with retro-reflective and fluorescent materials shall be 1,130 mm, the maximum total length shall be 2,300 mm.

requirements.text: The width of a rear marking plate shall be:.
requirements.quote: The width of a rear marking plate shall be:

requirements.text: The dimensions shall be 140 ± 10 mm. (for trucks and tractors).
requirements.quote: For trucks and tractors: 140 ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: The length of each rear marking plate in a set consisting of two plates for trucks and tractors, as illustrated in Figures A5-V and A5-VI, may be reduced, to a minimum of 130 mm, provided that the width is increased such that the area of each marking is at least 735 cm2, does not exceed 1,725 cm2 and the marking plates are rectangular.
requirements.quote: The length of each rear marking plate in a set consisting of two plates for trucks and tractors, as illustrated in Figures A5-V and A5-VI, may be reduced, to a minimum of 130 mm, provided that the width is increased such that the area of each marking is at least 735 cm2, does not exceed 1,725 cm2 and the marking plates are rectangular.

requirements.text: The width of the red fluorescent border of the rear marking plates for trailers and semi-trailers shall be 40 mm ± 1 mm.
requirements.quote: The width of the red fluorescent border of the rear marking plates for trailers and semi-trailers shall be 40 mm ± 1 mm.

requirements.text: The slope of the oblique stripes of the chevron band shall be 45º ± 5º.
requirements.quote: The slope of the oblique stripes of the chevron band shall be 45º ± 5º.

requirements.text: The width of the stripes shall be 100 mm ± 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: The width of the stripes shall be 100 mm ± 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: Rear marking plates supplied in sets shall form matching pairs.
requirements.quote: Rear marking plates supplied in sets shall form matching pairs.

requirements.text: The plates shall be in the shape of an equilateral triangle with truncated corners, for mounting with one apex upwards at the rear of slow-moving vehicles.
requirements.quote: Shape The plates shall be in the shape of an equilateral triangle with truncated corners, for mounting with one apex upwards at the rear of slow-moving vehicles.

requirements.text: The SMV rear marking plates shall have a red fluorescent centre and red retro-reflective borders made of either retro-reflective material or coating or of plastic corner-cube reflectors (class 1).
requirements.quote: Pattern The SMV rear marking plates shall have a red fluorescent centre and red retro-reflective borders made of either retro-reflective material or coating or of plastic corner-cube reflectors (class 1).

requirements.text: The SMV rear marking plates of class 2 shall have a retro-reflective centre.
requirements.quote: The SMV rear marking plates of class 2 shall have a retro-reflective centre.

requirements.text: The length of the base of the enclosed fluorescent triangle (class 1) or retro- reflective triangle (class 2) shall be: minimum 350 mm and maximum 365 mm.
requirements.quote: Dimensions The length of the base of the enclosed fluorescent triangle (class 1) or retro- reflective triangle (class 2) shall be: minimum 350 mm and maximum 365 mm.

requirements.text: The minimum width of the light-emitting surface of the red retro-reflective border shall be 45 mm, the maximum width 48 mm.
requirements.quote: The minimum width of the light-emitting surface of the red retro-reflective border shall be 45 mm, the maximum width 48 mm.

requirements.text: The theoretical sides of the triangle shall be 500 ± 50 mm long.
requirements.quote: The theoretical sides of the triangle shall be 500 ± 50 mm long.

requirements.text: In the case of an advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflecting units shall be arranged along the edge within a strip of an unvarying width which shall be between 25 mm and 50 mm.
requirements.quote: In the case of an advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflecting units shall be arranged along the edge within a strip of an unvarying width which shall be between 25 mm and 50 mm.

requirements.text: In the case of an advance warning triangle of type 2 with fluorescent retro-reflecting material, the unvarying width shall be between 50 mm and 85 mm.
requirements.quote: In the case of an advance warning triangle of type 2 with fluorescent retro-reflecting material, the unvarying width shall be between 50 mm and 85 mm.

requirements.text: Between the outer edge of the triangle and the retro-reflecting strip there may be an edging not more than 5 mm wide and not necessarily red-coloured.
requirements.quote: Between the outer edge of the triangle and the retro-reflecting strip there may be an edging not more than 5 mm wide and not necessarily red-coloured.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting strip may be continuous or not.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflecting strip may be continuous or not.

requirements.text: In the latter case the free area of the supporting material shall be red (see also paragraph 5.9.4.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.quote: In the latter case the free area of the supporting material shall be red (see also paragraph 5.9.4.2.1. of this Regulation).

requirements.text: In the case of an advance warning triangle of type 1, the fluorescent surface shall be continuous to the retro-reflecting units.
requirements.quote: In the case of an advance warning triangle of type 1, the fluorescent surface shall be continuous to the retro-reflecting units.

requirements.text: It shall be arranged symmetrically along the three sides of the triangle.
requirements.quote: It shall be arranged symmetrically along the three sides of the triangle.

requirements.text: When in use, its surface area shall be not less than 315 cm2.
requirements.quote: When in use, its surface area shall be not less than 315 cm2.

requirements.text: However, an edging, continuous or not, not more than 5 mm wide, which need not necessarily be red-coloured, may be placed between the retro-reflecting surface and the fluorescent surface.
requirements.quote: However, an edging, continuous or not, not more than 5 mm wide, which need not necessarily be red-coloured, may be placed between the retro-reflecting surface and the fluorescent surface.

requirements.text: The side of the open centre of the triangle shall have a minimum length of 70 mm (Figure A5-VIII).
requirements.quote: The side of the open centre of the triangle shall have a minimum length of 70 mm (Figure A5-VIII).

requirements.text: The distance between the supporting surface and the lower side of the advance warning triangle shall not exceed 300 mm.
requirements.quote: The distance between the supporting surface and the lower side of the advance warning triangle shall not exceed 300 mm

requirements.text: The fluorescent retro-reflecting material shall be coloured in the mass, either in the retro-reflective elements or as solid surface layer.
requirements.quote: The fluorescent retro-reflecting material shall be coloured in the mass, either in the retro-reflective elements or as solid surface layer.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be kept for 12 hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 ºC, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
requirements.quote: A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be kept for 12 hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 ºC, after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: It shall then be kept for 12 hours at a temperature of ‑ 20 °C ± 2 ºC.
requirements.quote: It shall then be kept for 12 hours at a temperature of ‑ 20 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: The sample shall be examined after a recovery time of 4 hours under normal laboratory conditions.
requirements.quote: The sample shall be examined after a recovery time of 4 hours under normal laboratory conditions.

requirements.text: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: In the case of a sample unit of retro-reflective marking the coefficient of retro-reflection R' shall be measured in conformity with Part 2 of Annex 6, the sample unit being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of a sample unit of retro-reflective marking the coefficient of retro-reflection R' shall be measured in conformity with Part 2 of Annex 6, the sample unit being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: The triangle - collapsible triangles are to be assembled as for use - shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water having a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being about 20 mm below the water surface.
requirements.quote: The triangle - collapsible triangles are to be assembled as for use - shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water having a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being about 20 mm below the water surface.

requirements.text: Immediately afterwards, this retro-reflective device shall be immersed under the same conditions in water having a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: Immediately afterwards, this retro-reflective device shall be immersed under the same conditions in water having a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: After this test, no water shall have penetrated to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.quote: After this test, no water shall have penetrated to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflective device.

requirements.text: Water or water vapour penetration into the edges of fluorescent retro-reflecting materials shall not be deemed to indicate failure.
requirements.quote: Water or water vapour penetration into the edges of fluorescent retro-reflecting materials shall not be deemed to indicate failure.

requirements.text: If the visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water, or in case of doubt the value of the RI shall again be measured under the same conditions as specified in paragraph 1.2. of Part 2 of Annex 6, after the retro-reflective device has been gently shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: If the visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water, or in case of doubt the value of the RI shall again be measured under the same conditions as specified in paragraph 1.2. of Part 2 of Annex 6, after the retro-reflective device has been gently shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: The RI shall not have diminished by more than 40 per cent of the values recorded before the test.
requirements.quote: The RI shall not have diminished by more than 40 per cent of the values recorded before the test.

requirements.text: The triangle - collapsible advance warning triangles are to be assembled as for use - shall be immersed flat for two hours on the bottom of a tank containing water at 25 °C ± 5 °C, with the active face of the triangle showing upwards and being 5 cm under the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Water test The triangle - collapsible advance warning triangles are to be assembled as for use - shall be immersed flat for two hours on the bottom of a tank containing water at 25 °C ± 5 °C, with the active face of the triangle showing upwards and being 5 cm under the surface of the water.

requirements.text: The triangle shall then be removed and dried.
requirements.quote: The triangle shall then be removed and dried.

requirements.text: No part of the device may exhibit clear signs of deterioration which might impair the effectiveness of the triangle.
requirements.quote: No part of the device may exhibit clear signs of deterioration which might impair the effectiveness of the triangle.

requirements.text: A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in distilled water at a temperature of 23 ± 5ºC for a period of 18 hours; it shall then be left to dry for 24 hours under normal laboratory conditions.
requirements.quote: Resistance to water A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in distilled water at a temperature of 23 ± 5ºC for a period of 18 hours; it shall then be left to dry for 24 hours under normal laboratory conditions.

requirements.text: After completion of the test, the section shall be examined.
requirements.quote: After completion of the test, the section shall be examined.

requirements.text: No part inside 10 mm from the cut edge shall show evidence of deterioration which would reduce the effectiveness of the plate.
requirements.quote: No part inside 10 mm from the cut edge shall show evidence of deterioration which would reduce the effectiveness of the plate.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.
requirements.quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.

requirements.text: A water spray cabinet with the following characteristics shall be used.
requirements.quote: Water spray test equipment A water spray cabinet with the following characteristics shall be used:

requirements.text: The cabinet shall be equipped with a nozzle(s) which provides a solid cone water spray of sufficient angle to completely cover the sample device.
requirements.quote: Cabinet The cabinet shall be equipped with a nozzle(s) which provides a solid cone water spray of sufficient angle to completely cover the sample device.

requirements.text: The centreline of the nozzle(s) shall be directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of a rotating test platform.
requirements.quote: The centreline of the nozzle(s) shall be directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of a rotating test platform.

requirements.text: The rotating test platform shall have a minimum diameter of 140 mm and rotate about a vertical axis in the centre of the cabinet.
requirements.quote: Rotating test platform The rotating test platform shall have a minimum diameter of 140 mm and rotate about a vertical axis in the centre of the cabinet.

requirements.text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
requirements.quote: Precipitation rate The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.

requirements.text: The height of the collector shall be 100 mm and the inside diameter shall be a minimum of 140 mm.
requirements.quote: The height of the collector shall be 100 mm and the inside diameter shall be a minimum of 140 mm.

requirements.text: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows.
requirements.quote: Water spray test procedure A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:

requirements.text: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
requirements.quote: Device openings All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.

requirements.text: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
requirements.quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.

requirements.text: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.
requirements.quote: Rotational speed The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.quote: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.quote: Test duration The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.quote: Drain period The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.

requirements.text: The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.quote: The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.

requirements.text: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.

requirements.text: The following equipment shall be used to test for dust exposure.
requirements.quote: Dust exposure test equipment The following equipment shall be used to test for dust exposure:

requirements.text: The interior of the test chamber shall be cubical in shape in size 0.9 to 1.5 m per side.
requirements.quote: Dust exposure test chamber The interior of the test chamber shall be cubical in shape in size 0.9 to 1.5 m per side.

requirements.text: The bottom may be "hopper shaped" to aid in collecting the dust.
requirements.quote: The bottom may be "hopper shaped" to aid in collecting the dust.

requirements.text: The internal chamber volume, not including a "hopper shaped" bottom shall be 2 m3 maximum and shall be charged with 3 to 5 kg of the test dust.
requirements.quote: The internal chamber volume, not including a "hopper shaped" bottom shall be 2 m3 maximum and shall be charged with 3 to 5 kg of the test dust.

requirements.text: The chamber shall have the capability of agitating the test dust by means of compressed air or blower fans in such a way that the dust is diffused throughout the chamber.
requirements.quote: The chamber shall have the capability of agitating the test dust by means of compressed air or blower fans in such a way that the dust is diffused throughout the chamber.

requirements.text: The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.* * American Society for Testing and Materials.
requirements.quote: The dust The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.* * American Society for Testing and Materials

requirements.text: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows.
requirements.quote: Dust exposure test procedure A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:

requirements.text: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
requirements.quote: Dust exposure The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.

requirements.text: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
requirements.quote: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.

requirements.text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.quote: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.

requirements.text: The dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.quote: The dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Measured sample evaluation Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.

requirements.text: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

requirements.text: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.quote: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.

requirements.text: After having brushed, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Advance warning triangle of type 1, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall then be covered or thoroughly wetted for one minute with a mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7.
requirements.quote: After having brushed, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of Advance warning triangle of type 1, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall then be covered or thoroughly wetted for one minute with a mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7.

requirements.text: The fuel shall then be removed and the device allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The fuel shall then be removed and the device allowed to dry.

requirements.text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
requirements.quote: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.

requirements.text: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.

requirements.text: In the case of the retro-reflector of an Advance warning triangle of type 1, the RI shall not have diminished by more than 40 per cent of the values recorded before the test.
requirements.quote: In the case of the retro-reflector of an Advance warning triangle of type 1, the RI shall not have diminished by more than 40 per cent of the values recorded before the test.

requirements.text: The apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity and shall be equipped with a water spray system.
requirements.quote: The apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 and shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity and shall be equipped with a water spray system.

requirements.text: The water spray system shall be capable to spray a minimum of 0.3 ml/cm² within 5 minutes.
requirements.quote: The water spray system shall be capable to spray a minimum of 0.3 ml/cm² within 5 minutes.

requirements.text: The spray water used shall be in accordance to the requirements of EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
requirements.quote: The spray water used shall be in accordance to the requirements of EN ISO 4892-2:2013.

requirements.text: The test method used shall be specified in the report.
requirements.quote: The test method used shall be specified in the report.

requirements.text: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6- 1: 3.1. in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours, 3.2. in case of fluorescent materials for a period of 100 hours.
requirements.quote: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6- 1: 3.1. in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours, 3.2. in case of fluorescent materials for a period of 100 hours.

requirements.text: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
requirements.quote: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.

requirements.text: This does not mean that the value may vary by plus/minus the amount indicated from the given value.
requirements.quote: This does not mean that the value may vary by plus/minus the amount indicated from the given value.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:.
requirements.quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.quote: (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.
requirements.quote: (b) After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.

requirements.text: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to. or;.
requirements.quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to. or;

requirements.text: A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in the test mixture for one minute.
requirements.quote: (a) A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in the test mixture for one minute.

requirements.text: After removal, the surface shall be wiped dry with a soft cloth and shall not show any visible change which would reduce its effective performance.
requirements.quote: (b) After removal, the surface shall be wiped dry with a soft cloth and shall not show any visible change which would reduce its effective performance.

requirements.text: The triangle and its protective cover shall be immersed separately in a tank containing a mixture of 70 per cent n-heptane and 30 per cent toluene.
requirements.quote: The triangle and its protective cover shall be immersed separately in a tank containing a mixture of 70 per cent n-heptane and 30 per cent toluene.

requirements.text: After 60 seconds they shall be removed from the tank and drained of excess liquid.
requirements.quote: (a) After 60 seconds they shall be removed from the tank and drained of excess liquid.

requirements.text: The triangle shall then be placed in its cover and the unit shall be laid flat in a still atmosphere.
requirements.quote: (b) The triangle shall then be placed in its cover and the unit shall be laid flat in a still atmosphere.

requirements.text: When completely dried, the triangle shall not adhere to its protective cover, and there shall be no visually noticeable change on its surface and shall not present apparent detrimental modifications; however, slight surface cracks may be tolerated.
requirements.quote: (c) When completely dried, the triangle shall not adhere to its protective cover, and there shall be no visually noticeable change on its surface and shall not present apparent detrimental modifications; however, slight surface cracks may be tolerated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: A test sample smeared with a mixture of detergent lubricating oil and graphite shall be easily cleaned without damage to the retro-reflective surface when wiped with a mild aliphatic solvent such as n-heptane, followed by washing with a neutral detergent.
requirements.quote: Manual cleaning A test sample smeared with a mixture of detergent lubricating oil and graphite shall be easily cleaned without damage to the retro-reflective surface when wiped with a mild aliphatic solvent such as n-heptane, followed by washing with a neutral detergent.

requirements.text: When subjected to a continuous spraying action for 60 seconds on the test component in its normal mounting conditions, a test sample shall show no damage to the retro-reflective surface or delamination from the substrate or separation from the sample mounting surface under the following set-up parameters.
requirements.quote: Power washing When subjected to a continuous spraying action for 60 seconds on the test component in its normal mounting conditions, a test sample shall show no damage to the retro-reflective surface or delamination from the substrate or separation from the sample mounting surface under the following set-up parameters:

requirements.text: The application shall be done according to the manufacturer’s recommendation.
requirements.quote: The application shall be done according to the manufacturer’s recommendation.

requirements.text: The adhesion of retro-reflective material shall be determined after 24 hours curing time by utilising a 90-degree peel on a tensile strength testing machine.
requirements.quote: The adhesion of retro-reflective material shall be determined after 24 hours curing time by utilising a 90-degree peel on a tensile strength testing machine.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective material shall not be easily removable without damaging the material.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective material shall not be easily removable without damaging the material.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective material shall need a force of at least 10 N per 25 mm width at a constant speed of 300 mm per minute to be removed from their substrate.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective material shall need a force of at least 10 N per 25 mm width at a constant speed of 300 mm per minute to be removed from their substrate.

requirements.text: A specimen of the sample unit that measures 50 mm by 300 mm shall be bent once lengthwise, around a 3.2 mm mandrel with adhesive contacting the mandrel for a period of 1 second.
requirements.quote: A specimen of the sample unit that measures 50 mm by 300 mm shall be bent once lengthwise, around a 3.2 mm mandrel with adhesive contacting the mandrel for a period of 1 second.

requirements.text: The test temperature shall be 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The test temperature shall be 23 °C ± 2 °C.

requirements.text: After this test, the specimen shall not have cracking of the surface and shall not show any visible change that would reduce its effective performance.
requirements.quote: After this test, the specimen shall not have cracking of the surface and shall not show any visible change that would reduce its effective performance.

requirements.text: When a 25 mm diameter solid steel ball is dropped from a height of 2 m onto the retro-reflective and fluorescent surfaces of a supported plate, at an ambient temperature of 23 ± 2 ºC, the material shall show no cracking or separation from the substrate at a distance of more than 5 mm from the impacted area.
requirements.quote: Rear marking plates (except for plastics corner‑cube reflectors) When a 25 mm diameter solid steel ball is dropped from a height of 2 m onto the retro-reflective and fluorescent surfaces of a supported plate, at an ambient temperature of 23 ± 2 ºC, the material shall show no cracking or separation from the substrate at a distance of more than 5 mm from the impacted area.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be mounted in a manner similar to the way in which it is mounted on the vehicle, but with the lens faced horizontal and directed upwards.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices of the Class IVA The retro-reflective device shall be mounted in a manner similar to the way in which it is mounted on the vehicle, but with the lens faced horizontal and directed upwards.

requirements.text: The ball may be guided but not restricted in free fall.
requirements.quote: The ball may be guided but not restricted in free fall.

requirements.text: When a retro-reflective device is tested at room temperature with this method, the lens shall not crack.
requirements.quote: When a retro-reflective device is tested at room temperature with this method, the lens shall not crack.

requirements.text: The rear marking plate shall be placed on two supports in such a way that the supports are parallel to the shorter edge of the plate and the distance from either support to the adjacent edge of the plate shall not exceed L 10, where L is the greater overall dimension of the plate.
requirements.quote: The rear marking plate shall be placed on two supports in such a way that the supports are parallel to the shorter edge of the plate and the distance from either support to the adjacent edge of the plate shall not exceed L 10, where L is the greater overall dimension of the plate.

requirements.text: The plate shall then be loaded with bags of shot or of dry sand to a uniformly distributed pressure of 1.5 kN/m2.
requirements.quote: The plate shall then be loaded with bags of shot or of dry sand to a uniformly distributed pressure of 1.5 kN/m2.

requirements.text: The deflection of the plate shall be measured at a point midway between the supports.
requirements.quote: The deflection of the plate shall be measured at a point midway between the supports.

requirements.text: When tested as described in paragraph 1.1. of Part 5 of Annex 8, the maximum deflection of the plate under the test load shall not exceed one twentieth of the distance between the supports in paragraph 1. and the residual deflection after removal of the load shall not exceed one fifth of the measured deflection under load.
requirements.quote: When tested as described in paragraph 1.1. of Part 5 of Annex 8, the maximum deflection of the plate under the test load shall not exceed one twentieth of the distance between the supports in paragraph 1. and the residual deflection after removal of the load shall not exceed one fifth of the measured deflection under load.

requirements.text: The triangular plate shall be strongly held on one of its long sides, with the clamps of the holding device not encroaching over more than 20 mm.
requirements.quote: The triangular plate shall be strongly held on one of its long sides, with the clamps of the holding device not encroaching over more than 20 mm.

requirements.text: A force of 10N perpendicular to the plane shall be applied to the opposite apex.
requirements.quote: A force of 10N perpendicular to the plane shall be applied to the opposite apex.

requirements.text: The apex shall then not move in the direction of the force by more than 40 mm.
requirements.quote: The apex shall then not move in the direction of the force by more than 40 mm.

requirements.text: After removal of the force, the plate shall visibly return to its initial position.
requirements.quote: After removal of the force, the plate shall visibly return to its initial position.

requirements.text: The residual deflection shall not be more than 5 mm.
requirements.quote: The residual deflection shall not be more than 5 mm.
